transform: Filter source validity intervals; retain sourced polygons; simplify rings at 0.018 degree tolerance, preserving small and dateline-crossing rings; round coordinates to 5 decimals. No generated or hand-drawn national territories.
limitations: 2026 is a membership scenario label, not a claim that the maintained basemap is a live military-control survey.
CShapes de-jure polygons do not imply wartime occupation.
1942 control has annual resolution and is not guaranteed to align to 1942-01-01.
1783 coverage is not exhaustive; source uncertainty and withheld records are disclosed.
